score_rationale: The agreement is standard and reciprocal, with balanced bilateral protections. Low risk overall, though perpetual trade secret protection and mandatory AAA arbitration in San Francisco require operational awareness.

clauses.title: Perpetual Trade Secret Confidentiality
clauses.risk_explanation: Extends confidentiality for trade secrets forever, creating permanent compliance tracking obligations.
clauses.quote: The confidentiality and non-use obligations set forth herein shall survive the termination or expiration of this Agreement and continue for a period of five (5) years following the date of initial disclosure, except with respect to Trade Secrets, which shall remain protected in perpetuity under applicable law.
clauses.counter_proposal: Limit trade secret obligations to a maximum of 7 years or until publicly known through lawful means.

clauses.title: Injunction Without Bond Requirement
clauses.risk_explanation: Allows the disclosing party to obtain an immediate court injunction without posting financial security to cover potential wrongful damages.
clauses.quote: Accordingly, Disclosing Party shall be entitled to seek equitable relief, including preliminary and permanent injunctive relief, without the necessity of posting a bond.
clauses.counter_proposal: Remove 'without the necessity of posting a bond' to require normal statutory judicial security.

clauses.title: Mandatory Binding AAA Arbitration
clauses.risk_explanation: Waives right to jury trial; sets arbitration venue exclusively in San Francisco, California.
clauses.quote: Any dispute arising out of or related to this Agreement shall be submitted to binding arbitration in San Francisco, California under the Commercial Rules of the American Arbitration Association (AAA).
clauses.counter_proposal: Maintain arbitration but stipulate virtual hearings to reduce travel expenses.

clauses.title: Complete Disclaimer of Warranties
clauses.risk_explanation: Standard for evaluation NDAs: shared information carries no warranty of accuracy or fitness.
clauses.quote: ALL CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION IS PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, OR NON-INFRINGEMENT.
clauses.counter_proposal: Include a basic representation that disclosing party has the right to disclose the materials.
